summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation has shifted from brittle CSS selectors toward LLM-driven extraction, natural-language queries, and autonomous browser agents that adapt to page changes. The 2026 landscape spans developer-first APIs (Firecrawl, Browserbase, AgentQL), large-scale marketplaces (Apify), no-code platforms (Browse.ai, Octoparse), and foundational open-source frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium) now augmented with AI. Tool choice typically comes down to whether you need clean LLM-ready output, full browser control, massive scale, or no-code simplicity.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; costs only for hosted/cloud execution via third parties
ai_features: Integrates with LLM agents via MCP (Playwright MCP server)
Used as the execution layer for many AI browser agents
Codegen and auto-waiting assist AI-driven test and scrape generation
strengths: Huge community and multi-language support (JS, Python, .NET, Java)
tools.best_for: Dynamic pages needing clicks, form fills, and full browser interaction, especially as the automation backbone for AI agents

tools.name: Puppeteer
ai_features: Commonly paired with LLMs to drive extraction and navigation
Foundation for many AI browser-agent frameworks
strengths: Deep Chromium control via DevTools Protocol
tools.best_for: Chromium-based headless automation and scraping of JavaScript-heavy sites

tools.name: Selenium
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; Selenium Grid self-hosted or paid cloud grids via vendors
ai_features: Integrates with AI testing/healing tools built on top of WebDriver
Used as execution layer for AI agents and self-healing frameworks
tools.best_for: Cross-browser automation and large-scale legacy test/scrape infrastructure

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from ~$16/mo (Hobby) to ~$333/mo (Standard/Growth); credit-based usage
ai_features: LLM-ready clean Markdown/JSON output
Natural-language extraction via /extract endpoint
Lovable integration for building scraping workflows with natural language
Built for RAG pipelines
strengths: Clean, structured output optimized for LLMs
tools.best_for: Feeding clean web data into LLM and RAG pipelines with minimal setup

tools.name: Apify
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with $5 monthly credit; paid plans from ~$49/mo (Starter) to ~$499/mo (Scale) plus usage
ai_features: AI-ready datasets for LLMs
LLM-integrated Actors and RAG tooling
MCP server for agent access to Actors
tools.best_for: Large-scale scraping and automation using prebuilt or custom Actors on managed cloud infrastructure

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier (limited browser hours); paid from ~$99/mo plus usage; enterprise custom
ai_features: Headless browser infrastructure for AI agents
Stagehand framework for natural-language browser actions
LLM-driven navigation and extraction
strengths: Built specifically for AI agent workloads
tools.best_for: Running AI browser agents at scale with reliable managed browser infrastructure

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.pricing_paid: Free developer tier; paid plans from ~$99/mo based on API calls
ai_features: AI-powered semantic query language for locating elements
Natural-language data extraction resilient to DOM changes
Integrates with Playwright and agent frameworks
strengths: Works across layout changes without rewrites
tools.best_for: Building durable scrapers and agents that query pages by meaning rather than brittle selectors

tools.name: Browse AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with limited credits; paid plans from ~$19/mo (Starter) to ~$500+/mo (Scale)
ai_features: No-code AI robots trained by example
Automatic adaptation to site changes
Natural-language setup and monitoring
tools.best_for: Non-developers monitoring websites and extracting structured data without code

tools.name: Octoparse
tools.pricing_paid: Free plan; paid from ~$99/mo (Standard) to ~$249/mo (Professional); enterprise custom
ai_features: AI-assisted auto-detection of data fields
AI web scraping templates
Automatic pagination and workflow detection
strengths: Large template library for common sites
tools.best_for: No-code users running recurring structured-data extraction at moderate scale

tools.name: Diffbot
tools.pricing_paid: 14-day trial; paid plans from ~$299/mo (Startup) with higher tiers and enterprise
ai_features: Computer-vision and ML-based page classification
Automatic structured extraction (Article, Product, etc.) APIs
Knowledge Graph with entity extraction
tools.best_for: Enterprise-scale automated extraction and knowledge-graph building across the web

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; self-hosted (infra costs only)
ai_features: LLM-ready Markdown and structured output
LLM-based extraction strategies
Designed for RAG and agent ingestion
strengths: Fast, open-source, highly popular on GitHub
Flexible extraction strategies and async crawling
tools.best_for: Developers wanting a free, self-hosted LLM-friendly crawler for RAG pipelines

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.pricing_paid: Open-source library free; hosted API with free credits and usage-based paid plans
ai_features: LLM-driven scraping via natural-language prompts
Graph-based extraction pipelines
Works with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, local models)
tools.best_for: Python developers building prompt-driven LLM scraping pipelines
